# Verify that --blur masks dynamic content for stable screenshot comparison.
# The page has a random session ID and timestamp that change on every load.
# Without blur, consecutive screenshots would differ. With blur applied to
# the dynamic elements, the comparison passes.

# First load: capture becomes the baseline.
navigate /blur-dynamic.html
wait-visible '#card'
sleep 500ms
screenshot-compare --blur '#session-id' --blur '#timestamp' '#card' blur-card.png
stdout 'baseline created'

# Reload the page; session ID and timestamp change.
navigate /blur-dynamic.html
wait-visible '#card'
sleep 500ms

# Second capture should stay within tolerance because dynamic content is blurred.
screenshot-compare --threshold 25 --blur '#session-id' --blur '#timestamp' '#card' blur-card.png
stdout 'diff:'
